verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes dlt purely as a Python library for extracting/loading data from APIs, databases, files, etc. (pull-based, batch/incremental), including REST API sources, CLI, MCP server for pipeline debugging, and AI harness for coding agents — none of this describes receiving or subscribing to inbound webhook events. No mention of webhook endpoints, event subscriptions, or push-based triggers appears anywhere in the pack.
